heartbeat_means: Refreshed when the run writes a line to stdout, at most once per 30 s, or at once when the line changes the stage, and the line it came from is the `stage` in status.json. RayWorkPool prints a progress line only after ray.wait has returned completed work, and in this repository no more often than every 300 s (main.py's MIN_NOTIFY_INTERVAL), so a fresh heartbeat from it means work completed within about five minutes. Ray also forwards the workers' own output to the driver's stdout, so a worker's line beats too, without moving the stage. It does NOT mean any Ray actor is progressing, and the converse does not hold: a stage that prints nothing for longer than the staleness window (900 s, `list --stale-after`), such as a queue whose items each take longer than that, is reported stale while it works. Stale means go and look.
